intakeAndReceiptContract.completionRequirement: Each gate requires an independently accepted, redacted, signed/dated decision or evidence receipt with reviewer role, source hash, reviewed branch/SHA, observed-at time and revalidation result.
intakeAndReceiptContract.supersession: Later evidence may supersede a stale or incomplete field only by appending a new receipt that explicitly binds the predecessor packet/receipt hash and states what changed. Existing packets and ledger rows are never edited in place.
intakeAndReceiptContract.ledgerRule: No ledger row is created until the owner/external evidence is independently accepted. This packet has receiptRow none and does not authorize a ledger append.
intakeAndReceiptContract.ownerDecisionRule: Null decision fields mean no decision was made. Local source defaults, prior snapshots, asserted roles and inventory observations must not be promoted to owner authorization.

globalRevalidationAndSafety.stalenessRule: Every receipt must be revalidated against current branch, exact reviewed SHA, source hashes, provider observation time and relevant schema/dependency/config state. Any drift, missing provenance or expired waiver returns the gate to awaiting evidence.
globalRevalidationAndSafety.redactionRule: No secrets, tokens, credentials, private keys, raw environment values, private hosts, raw logs, sensitive query literals, unmasked screenshots or provider payloads may enter this packet or its later receipts.
globalStopKillConditions: unknown destructive migration or privilege drift
request expands into apply, deploy, staging, canary, cleanup, provider or database mutation without separate explicit authorization
evidence conflicts with the append-only ledger or protected hashes
any exception lacks a named owner and expiry
globalRevalidationAndSafety.nextResumeAction: Collect and independently review the redacted signed/dated gate receipts in this packet, then append no ledger row until acceptance criteria and predecessor binding pass.
